name: io.github.borgels/mcp-server-billy
title: Billy
description: Unofficial MCP server for Billy (Danish accounting): invoices, contacts, books, payments.

environmentVariables.name: BILLY_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Access token of one Billy company (Billy: Settings -> Access tokens).

environmentVariables.name: BILLY_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the Billy API. Default https://api.billysbilling.com/v2.

environmentVariables.name: BILLY_AUDIT_LOG
environmentVariables.description: Path of the JSONL audit log. Write tools refuse to run if it cannot be written.
